user_review:
​Afiyet Restaurant in Başakşehir delivers far more than just a great meal; it provides a seamless, professionally engineered dining experience that serves as a live lesson in operational excellence and teamwork.
​The Process: A Seamless Customer Journey
​The restaurant utilizes a brilliant, multi-stage service flow that guides guests effortlessly from entry to table:
​The Empowered Selection: The journey begins at the private, in-house butchery on the ground floor, where a specialized team elegantly displays fresh meats, allowing you to customize your exact cuts, followed by a dedicated section to select your appetizers.
​The Perfect Handover: As you move upstairs to the dining area, a friendly, synchronized service team takes over your order, transitioning smoothly into the preparation and grilling phases without a single hitch.
​Premium Delivery: The final presentation is immaculate, backed by high-end hospitality and attentiveness.
​
The entire venue is spotless, serving as a clear indicator of a strong internal safety and quality culture.
​Staff Professionalism & Collaboration: A flawless live example of true teamwork; every single staff member knows their role perfectly, executing it with precision and synergy.
​Overall Atmosphere: Highly organized, professional, and welcoming, making it an excellent standard for hospitality.
​

To get the full experience, take your time during the initial selection phase at the ground-floor butchery. Personalizing your meat cuts and pairing them with their fresh, specialized appetizers right at the start sets the perfect tone for the premium service that follows upstairs.

user_review:
It wasn’t bad, but somehow because of the prices I was expecting something better.

We ordered calamari in tempura, and it’s the tempura that was just way too thick, and because of it, you just couldn’t taste the actual calamari. The sauce that came with it didn’t have a lot of taste nor the tempura calamari.

For the mains we a got sea bass with sweet potato puree and kind of chips - the dish was okay, but was lacking that „something”, the flavour, that kick.

We also got beef tenderloin which was definitely the best of all. It had lots of flavour and was very tasty. We asked for medium cooked, it was more on medium well side.

Worth adding that all the 3 dishes were on a smaller size.

For those 3 dishes and a big bottle of water we paid  4100 TL.

Before coming in, we checked the menu in photos someone shared in Google 10 months ago, the prizes since then went really up. The same calamari dish 10 months ago costed 390 TL, today —> 720 TL.

Big thank you though for a great service, the waiter was very kind, and because we had to wait longer for our main dishes, we received a free dessert - thank you for that!

user_review:
As soon as you enter, a very sweet uncle and aunt greet you. I've tried many çiğköfte (raw meatball) places from established chains like Komagene and Ömer Usta before, but the various çiğköfte I've had at Biberzade were nothing like this. Their Taco Çiğköfte, Sushi Roll Çiğköfte varieties, appetizers, and garnishes are a true flavor explosion. They also have baklava varieties brought from Gaziantep, which are reasonably priced and very delicious.

Fatma Abla is the owner and manager of the place. She's very skilled in sushi çiğköfte and a very sweet person. I wholeheartedly recommend it.

The prices are very reasonable, the portions are filling, and they offer a wonderful experience.

If you’re visiting Dolmabahçe Palace, I highly recommend stopping by Limonluk Cafe — it’s easily the best restaurant inside the palace area.

Set inside a beautiful glasshouse with European-inspired décor, the café has a charming, cozy, and elegant atmosphere. It’s a lovely place to relax for a while, especially after walking around the palace grounds.

It wasn’t too crowded when I visited, and the noise level was perfectly comfortable. While it may be slightly on the pricier side, it’s reasonable for a light meal or coffee given the location and ambiance.

If you’re already exploring the palace and need a short break, it’s definitely worth a stop.

user_review:
Well designed restaurant, lots of interesting nautical related artefacts displayed on the walls.

Prompt, professional and polite service. Food was served fast and hot. Staff were clearly experienced and worked well together.

We ordered a number of dishes and found the mixed salad with cheese and fish soup excellent. Midye Dolma (mussels with rice) was really pricy for the portion size. Levrek Kavurma was done really well, mushrooms and well buttered and onions caramelised but fish was a little strong for me. Istavrit Tava was really well fried but the bones of the fish were bigger and too prickly to eat and swallow. A little disappointed by the food given the 5.0 ratings here but the place was really popular and had many locals so it might just be a me problem.

Clean WC, but really hot as there was no fans and we came in summer with daytime temperatures of 30 degrees. We were seated on the second floor and there were tiny flies flying around.

user_review: This is absolutely a terrible establishment. We were completely dissatisfied with everything from the products to the service, and we definitely do not recommend it. We went there to buy a Berliner. There was an elderly man at the cashier, and when we asked what flavors they had, he just said, "Whatever you see, that's all we have." At the point of payment, we wanted to pay with a food card, and when he asked if they had Metropol, we said, "My wife has a Setcard, let's pay with that then," and he said they didn't have it either. Then we questioned why they accepted food cards at the door, and he just said, "Don't worry about that." Then a female staff member came to take payment with a Metropol card. When we said, "But you said they didn't accept it," she tried to evade the question by saying, "I don't know how to handle it." The Berliner was so bad we couldn't eat it; it looked like it was made in oil that had been used for frying 500 times. Don't give money to businesses like this!!

user_review:
Sushi Yakudza is one of the best sushi restaurants I’ve tried in Istanbul. They offer a wide variety of sushi and Japanese dishes, with plenty of options to choose from, and the prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the food.

The atmosphere is cozy and enjoyable, making it a great place to have dinner with friends or family. The food may take a little time to prepare, but everything is made fresh, and the quality is definitely worth the wait.

My personal favorite is the fried sushi burger, which is absolutely delicious and something I highly recommend trying.

Overall, Sushi Yakudza is one of the best sushi spots I’ve visited in Istanbul, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for high-quality sushi and Japanese cuisine at a fair price.

user_review:
We were in the mood for something fishy, which is why we chose this place. The location is fantastic—right by the sea. We arrived around 1:30 PM, and it was quiet and quite hot, which made it feel like this spot is more geared towards dinner service.

That said, we had a wonderful lunch. My wife and I shared a beautifully prepared fish for two, accompanied by a fresh and tasty salad. The fish was perfectly cooked and full of flavor, and the salad was crisp and refreshing.

Service was attentive and pleasant throughout. I’m giving it 4 stars—mainly because I found the prices to be about 15–20% higher than expected. Still, all in all, a lovely experience with excellent food and a great setting :)

user_review:
Sultan Balık in Florya is one of the best fish restaurants I have ever visited in Istanbul. From the moment you arrive, the experience feels very high quality and luxurious. The service is excellent from the very beginning, starting outside the restaurant and continuing throughout the whole dining experience.

The atmosphere is elegant and relaxing, with a very classy vibe that makes the place feel special. The seafood is fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented, and the overall quality of both the food and service is outstanding.

I highly recommend Sultan Balık if you are looking for a unique seafood experience or a special luxury dining spot in Istanbul. Definitely a place worth visiting for high-quality food and exceptional service.

Attention to the receipt! I was given an incorrect one, which had an extra £190.
They pretended not to know or acted like it was a mistake.
The service was cold, and the staff seemed upset, nervous, even a bit aggressive.
The atmosphere, due to the staff’s energy, was heavy, and the place was full of smoke.
It might be recommended for hookah, alcohol, and junk food, but not as a proper restaurant.
The food was okay. There wasn’t much they could mess up: fries, rice, meatballs.
Overall, the food I ordered was fine, but I wouldn’t return to this place.

We had an absolutely wonderful experience here from start to finish. It was one of those meals where you truly slow down and enjoy every moment. We started with a traditional Turkish drink, paired with incredibly fresh and delicious meze each one better than the last, simple yet full of flavor.

To finish, we chose a fresh fish, selected by us and perfectly grilled. The quality and freshness were outstanding, and you could really taste the care in how it was prepared.

The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Overall, it was a beautiful combination of great flavors, freshness, and genuine enjoyment — a place that turns a meal into a memorable experience. Highly recommended. 🐟✨

Start from the begging - the place feels special and very cozy.

After we entered waiters were super polite and helpful, they helped with making choice and it was super right! And for sure servis is incredible, fast and professional.

Now the main part about food - all mezzes and hot starters were full of taste and pretty  flavours . I’m a person who is really into this type of food and I’ve visited the best rated Istanbul places. I can honestly say that I recommend Cundali Bahce. You should definitely try calmar with cheese with additional mushrooms, with more mushrooms it could be even better 🤤! And all mezzes from my pics, my fav is deniz borulcesi!

If you are looking for a place for enjoying food and very local and cozy atmosphere- this place is for you. Also I noticed that public here are high quality, you will feel so comfortable here.

user_review:
We had some doubts before eating here, but it turned out to be one of the best meals of our entire 9-day trip in Istanbul.
After walking around the whole island, we decided to stop here — and it completely exceeded our expectations.
The grilled sea bream was excellent — fresh, perfectly cooked, simple and full of flavor. One of the best fish dishes I had on the trip. We also tried the chicken, which was good and very reasonably priced.
What really surprised us was the value for money. For a place on the island and close to the ferry area, the prices are fair and the quality is much better than expected.
Definitely not a tourist trap — highly recommended.

Please, charge 10-20 TL more for coffee, but please, address this hygiene issue!!! user_review:
Park Antalya Restaurant is truly one of the hidden gems of Ataşehir. From the moment we arrived, the experience was outstanding from start to finish. The restaurant enjoys a very convenient and central location, making it easily accessible whether you are meeting friends, family, or business associates.

What impressed me most was the quality and freshness of the food. Every dish we ordered was clearly prepared fresh and served with great attention to detail. The ingredients tasted high-quality, the flavors were well-balanced, and every plate arrived beautifully presented. It is evident that the kitchen takes pride in maintaining consistent standards.

The portions are exceptionally generous and satisfying. Unlike many places where presentation comes at the expense of quantity, Park Antalya delivers both. Every meal was filling and offered excellent value for money. Considering the quality of the ingredients, the freshness of the preparation, and the portion sizes, the price-performance ratio is outstanding.

Another highlight of the experience was the service. The waiters were attentive, professional, friendly, and always present when needed without ever being intrusive. They made us feel genuinely welcome and were happy to answer questions and accommodate requests. Their hospitality added significantly to the overall dining experience.

The atmosphere is comfortable, inviting, and suitable for both casual meals and special occasions. Combined with the delicious food, generous portions, reasonable prices, and exceptional service, it creates a dining experience that is difficult to fault.

I highly recommend Park Antalya Restaurant to anyone visiting Ataşehir or looking for a reliable place to enjoy fresh, delicious food with excellent service. I will certainly be returning and look forward to trying even more dishes from their menu.

description: Perry Coffee - Kısım, Ataköy 7-8-9-10. Kısım, Lale Sk. Gazi Sitesi No:2-o, 34110 Bakırköy/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
*Welcome and Atmosphere*
From the moment we stepped into the cafe, we were greeted with a very warm and professional attitude. I would like to especially thank the owner, Mr. İrfan, who took great care of us, from seating us at our table to offering dessert and coffee recommendations, and whose politeness made a difference. The place is designed with bohemian architecture; it has a very stylish and calming atmosphere that doesn't strain the eyes. The music playing in the background is chosen to create a pleasant background that doesn't interrupt conversation. *Space and Visiting Hours*
The design of the place is quite ideal for groups of 4-5 people. For larger groups (8-10 people), combining tables may be necessary. A small note for those planning a visit: We were there around 2 PM and the atmosphere was extremely quiet; these hours are perfect for those who want to focus or take care of their business. We learned that it reaches full capacity during rush hour, but calmness returns after 9 PM. I recommend planning accordingly. *Taste Experience: Coffee and Accompaniments*
Although I'm not particularly picky about coffee, I found the smooth-drinking coffee I tried, recommended by the staff, to be truly excellent. The desserts were absolutely perfect; the sugar level was so balanced that it never overwhelmed you and didn't detract from the coffee's flavor. There's one detail my friend who accompanied me today specifically asked me to mention: you absolutely must try the San Sebastian cheesecake; its taste is truly unforgettable. *Price - Performance and Overall Assessment*
Prices are quite average by today's cafe standards. However, considering the peaceful atmosphere, tranquility, and quality of service, I think you get more than your money's worth. In fact, I can say that the prices are quite reasonable for this quality. *Conclusion*
Whether you want to work quietly on your computer after leaving home, read a book with a quality coffee, or have a friendly chat with friends, you can choose this place. It's a great stop for a short break after work or to organize your next "coffee date." Even if you go out of your way a little, it will definitely be worth it to stop here.

description: Balata Et Steakhouse - Yıldırım, Şht. Kamil Balkan Cd. No:34, 34100 Bayrampaşa/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
GREAT EXPERIENCE BUT WATCH OUT!!

To start, and in one word, the foods here especially the grills is second to none. We heve tried many restaurants in Istanbul, but the food here is too excellent and you will undoubtedly have a very memorable experience. The grills particularly note the iconic deliciousness of Turkish kebab and food. The freshness, quality and presentation are exceptionally outstanding. The plates were served with a great show: live grilling for a few minutes of a precooked dish, and the drink was served in a unique way (a special type of filter that generates a smooth sound and creates a spectacular show that stimulates your appetite). The drink, by the way was called Ali Baba, a house-made drink, which is a delicious combination of fruits and herbs. I totally recommend trying it.

There was also a free shuttle from a 5-minues away hotel that picked us up and dropped us off after our visit.

The gentleman in charge that we met at the restaurant is well-experienced and very welcoming, and spoke good English.

Having the above been said, we went around 01:30 AM for a quick late bite, and after being given the menus, we were invited to see the types of available grills, and that I believe was the commercial trap that we fell for. We chose what we wanted, however, long story short, all referred other extra presentation show that the food was served with (and that WE DID NOT ASK FOR) was obviously being charged on my bill without my approval and without prior notice AT ALL. The total bill was over 2900 TL.

To sum up, the experience is definitely worth the try for once, but not informing the customers about what they are being charged for is definitely a red flag in this restaurant. This is why I am rating this place 2 stars while I think I am being a bit overgenerous.

I recommend checking what you'll be paying for before ordering anything if you don't want to have a good-but experience.

description: Vadi Cafe - Başak Gül Sokak, Sular Vadisi, Başak, Başakşehir 4. Etap, 34480 Başakşehir/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
Exceptional Shisha Experience at Vadi Cafe.

Had the pleasure of visiting Vadi Cafe recently and it absolutely exceeded all of my expectations.

The highlight of the visit was, undoubtedly, their top-notch Shisha. I daresay it's one of the best I've experienced in Istanbul. The variety of flavors on offer were tantalizing and unique, making the whole experience one to remember. The quality of the smoke was smooth, flavorful, and delightfully aromatic, truly demonstrating their mastery over the art of Shisha.

Equally impressive was their range of drinks. From traditional Turkish teas to innovative cocktails, each was expertly crafted and absolutely brimming with flavor. They added a refreshing complement to the Shisha, making the combination a sensory delight.

The ambiance is what tied everything together for me. The cafe is imbued with a sense of tranquility and warmth that is rare to find. The cozy atmosphere made it the perfect place to unwind, relax and simply enjoy the present. The soft lighting and comfortable seating added to the overall inviting atmosphere, making you feel instantly at home.

Customer service was also worth a mention. The staff were courteous, professional, and attended to our needs promptly. They made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed for an enjoyable evening.

In conclusion, Vadi Cafe is a must-visit for any Shisha aficionado in Istanbul. The combination of exceptional Shisha, delightful drinks, and a relaxing ambiance create a uniquely satisfying experience. Highly recommended!

description: Scarpetta - Etiler, Dilhayat Sk. No: 16, 34337 Beşiktaş/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
We came for something simple: some appetizers, a pizza, and pasta. I had visited about a year ago for dinner and definitely prefer the evening vibes to the afternoon ones.
The facade of the area we were at needs a touch of repainting, which for an upscale restaurant, isn't pleasing to the eyes—another plus for eating at night when you don’t see these things.

Pros:
We had the burrata, which in my opinion, was one of the yummiest I've had so far in Istanbul. It had an interesting eggplant puree as a base, giving it a unique flavor. The burrata itself wasn't cold out of the fridge, which is unfortunately how it’s often served at several Italian restaurants in Istanbul (yes, I have a thing for burrata).

The pizza, a Margherita, was good—nothing too exciting or mind-blowing.

Cons:
The bruschetta wasn't up to par at all. While they had their own twist with cooked tomatoes instead of raw, it wasn’t a success. It almost felt like eating un-pureed pasta sauce on soggy bread. No basil flavor anywhere, unfortunately.

The pasta was very underwhelming and lacked flavor. We had a simple tomato pasta and one with clams. The latter was overcooked and chewy.

Would I come here again? Unfortunately, no.

For the price, it did not live up to expectations.

user_review: I saw it randomly while passing by and watched it from afar for a while. The staff were attentive, and the fact that it wasn't cooked over charcoal was what attracted me. It was cool, and since there was no room inside, I sat outside. The takeaway was quite busy; I placed my order, and my toasted bread arrived. The bread was delightful, and the meatballs were equally delightful, juicy, and delicious. I didn't see cumin, black pepper, or chili flakes on the tables; I think they definitely would have brought them if I had asked. A piyaz (onion salad) and a nice yogurt would have livened up the atmosphere, but they said they couldn't make the piyaz due to lack of space. I think if they put the remaining charcoal embers in a pot and cooked them overnight before serving, it would be a nice option to accompany these meatballs. It's an economical place where you can find delicious food. Good luck!

One of the best pasta restaurants I have tried in Turkiye honestly . Located beside a park close to the Avcılar square. Went with my friend, the owners a man and his wife were so kind and welcoming, they make you feel like it's your place.We ordered fettuccine and menemen. user_review:
The best restaurant in the area!
The menu isn’t huge, which means every dish is carefully prepared and absolutely delicious.
This is real Turkish cuisine you simply can’t walk past.

I stayed nearby for three days and came here every single day with my whole family.

I highly recommend trying the soup — it’s a light and perfect start to the day, and only 100 lira.
The lamb döner is absolutely incredible.
They also serve a meat tenderloin (900 lira), and one portion is enough for a group.

And most importantly, you don’t have to wait for your food for hours.
Thanks to the constant flow of customers, the dishes are prepared with amazing speed — I waited only about 5–10 minutes for my orders.
The waiters are friendly and make sure you’re never bored :)

user_review:
I recently visited Arnavutköy Döner Geces and was really pleasantly surprised. The restaurant has a very nice atmosphere – modern, clean, and at the same time cozy. It’s a great place to go out to eat with friends or family.

The döner was absolutely top quality: the meat was juicy, perfectly seasoned, and freshly sliced from the spit. The bread was also crispy and fresh, which made the overall taste even better.

The service was friendly and fast as well. The staff was attentive and took their time, even though the restaurant was quite busy. The portions are generous and the price-to-value ratio is definitely fair. The staff was also very child-friendly, which made the experience even more pleasant.

user_review:
This restaurant exceeded all of our expectations and gave us one of the best dining experiences we’ve had.

From the moment we arrived, our waiter, Ramazan, made us feel genuinely welcome. His attentiveness, professionalism, and warm hospitality made the evening even more enjoyable.

Every dish was beautifully prepared, fresh, and absolutely delicious. The hot and cold appetizers were bursting with rich, balanced flavors, and each course was better than the last. The biggest surprise was that even the pickiest eater in our group eagerly tried every dish—and loved them all!

The desserts were true edible works of art, as stunning to look at as they were delightful to taste.

We’ll definitely remember this evening as a celebration of gastronomic excellence and culinary mastery. Thank you for an unforgettable experience—we can’t wait to return!

description: Saltbae Burger - IGA, Istanbul Arpt, Dış Hatlar Terminali, Tayakadın, Terminal Caddesi No:1, 34283 Arnavutköy/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
After a memorable cruise journey and departing from Istanbul , my final meal was at Saltbae in Istanbul Airport. Curiosity got the better of me, so I decided to try their signature Golden Burger, wrapped in edible gold leaf, a touch of theatrical flair synonymous with the Saltbae brand.

The burger certainly lived up to its visual appeal. Beneath the shimmering gold leaf was a thick, juicy beef patty, complemented by smoked beef, crispy onions, melted cheddar, and a rich, savoury sauce. More than just a gimmick, it was genuinely satisfying. The flavours were well balanced, the beef was succulent, and every bite felt indulgent without being overwhelming.

What surprised me most was the portion size. It was considerably larger than expected and came with a generous serving of crispy French fries, making it a substantial meal rather than a novelty. Coupled with the restaurant’s modern, vibrant ambience and the unmistakable Saltbae branding, it provided a fitting finale to my culinary experiences in Türkiye.

It was an enjoyable lunch,hearty, satisfying, and a memorable way to conclude my visit before boarding my flight home.

user_review:
⭐⭐⭐☆☆

We visited this restaurant for the first time, and our experience was mixed. The best part of the meal was definitely the appetizers. Chicken wings and The hummus and the other starters were delicious and the highlight of our visit.

Unfortunately, the service was disappointing. Even though we ordered a lot of food, only about half of our order arrived. It was difficult to communicate because most of the staff didn’t speak English, and they weren’t very helpful in making sure we received everything we ordered. Even when we asked about the missing dishes, we felt ignored and had to keep asking.

There was only one staff member who could speak English or Arabic, which made communication much easier when we found them. Since this restaurant welcomes tourists, I think the owner should invest more in customer service and ensure the staff can better assist international guests.

The food we did receive was good, especially the appetizers, but the service needs significant improvement.

user_review:
We visited Zeugma Terrace Steak House during our stay in Istanbul and it became our favourite restaurant of the trip.

The food was excellent, the coffee was one of the best we had in the city, and even though we weren’t planning to order dessert, we simply couldn’t resist and were glad we did.

What made this place truly special was the atmosphere. The service was professional, friendly and genuinely welcoming. Every member of the team made us feel comfortable and cared for without being intrusive.

The terrace offers beautiful views, the setting is elegant and relaxing, and everything feels thoughtfully organised.

We visited several highly rated restaurants in Istanbul, but this was the place we enjoyed the most.

Highly recommended for both couples and families. We will definitely come back on our next visit to Istanbul.

user_review: On Friday, February 6th, 2026, we visited this charming place that makes cookies. First of all, it operates on a takeaway/buffet system. Although we saw many advertisements for it on social media, we were able to buy directly without queuing. I tasted all the varieties, which I've shared pictures of in the attachment, and I truly believe I ate a delicious Kavala cookie. Other than that, I didn't find anything original in the apple pie and other products mentioned in the advertisements. There is a parking problem in the area; parking is difficult except for the nearby shopping mall or the small parking areas below the shop. If you choose to go there, you can get there quickly by taking the Marmaray and getting off at Bakırköy station, a very short walk away. Enjoy your meal…

user_review: From the hygiene and warm, friendly welcome to the delicious food, we've become regulars despite it being newly opened. Instead of having tea or coffee at home in the evenings, we started going to Wee. Then we discovered they also serve breakfast, so we went there with the girls and loved it. The atmosphere was perfect for a relaxed conversation, and the fact that it's a family business made us feel comfortable. And the prices... the prices are very, very good and ideal. Having gotten tired of the exorbitant prices in the market, discovering Wee Coffee made me very happy. The prices are great, and the service and flavors are amazing for that price. I had a wedding coming up soon, and I spoke with the establishment, telling them I wanted to create my wedding favors there in a workshop-like event. They were so kind and helpful in preparing, I was so pleased. I've included pictures here. The food they offered was amazing, my guests loved it. Thank you Wee Coffee 🍰🧁🥞🍪

A Turkish friend recommended it as one of the most authentic künefe spots in Istanbul and honestly, it's a must-try if you live here!

user_review:
When I walked in, they immediately seated me and poured a glass of water without asking. I initially mistook it for good service. They offered several starters — I ordered one — then a main course and a beer.
When the bill arrived, I was stunned: 2000 lira and five items I clearly did not order. I paid only because the receipt was impossible to understand and the staff spoke no English.
Later, a Turkish colleague explained that they charged 120 lira for a simple glass of water and 190 lira for a dessert I never ordered. This is not a misunderstanding — it is deliberate fraud targeting tourists.
This place operates dishonestly. Stay away, especially if you are not from Turkey.

user_review:
Unfortunately, this was a disappointing experience, and I wouldn’t come back.

I saw a lot of positive reviews on Instagram and Google Maps, so I decided to visit with my friends, even though it was quite far from where we live. It was 3 PM and there were no other customers but us — which probably should’ve been a sign.

We ordered three student burrito sets, one beef taco, and one chicken taco. We waited in the heat for almost 45-50 minutes, which felt far too long for such simple orders..

But the worst part was when the food finally arrived. The presentation was nice and the burrito size was good, but the taste was a huge disappointment, this is definitely not real Mexican food…not even close. There was no Mexican sauce or flavor at all! The chicken in the burrito felt like frozen supermarket chicken strips, and 60% of the sandwich was just old fried potatoes, even the hot sauce was Turkish-style, if they changed the chicken, this could’ve easily passed for a döner wrap instead of a burrito🤷🏻‍♀️

The tacos were also disappointing, way too much cheddar cheese, making them heavy and overwhelming, the beef was a little bit dry and nothing about it stood out as tasty.

Overall, the food wasn’t exactly bad in flavor, but it had nothing to do with real Mexican cuisine..

I definitely won’t be returning, but to be fair, the portion sizes were generous and the prices were average to slightly expensive🤝🏻

The quality of the ingredients is evident in every bite and the variety allows you to create a meal tailored to your tastes.
The entire experience was satisfying, enjoyable and memorable. From the excellent food and great service to the interactive dining concept, this is a restaurant I would gladly recommend to anyone looking for a top-quality meat dining experience in Istanbul.

user_review:
We recently stopped by Beylerbeyi Profiterol, a local gem in Istanbul — a place that’s truly a paradise for dessert lovers! The store is quite busy, and it’s easy to see why: they serve a wonderful variety of desserts, alongside both hot and cold drinks.

We came as a group of 10 and ordered 5 different desserts to share, along with some traditional Turkish tea. We liked the Original Profiterol the most — rich, creamy, and perfectly sweet — and the Cold Baklava was another highlight. I also really enjoyed their San Sebastian Cheesecake, which was silky smooth with just the right texture.

The store offers both indoor and outdoor seating, and everything is spotless and well maintained. The service is truly one of a kind — professional, friendly, kind, and attentive. They even guide you toward choosing the best treats to suit your taste. We want to give a special thanks to Mr. Ugur, the owner, for his warm hospitality and for making us feel so welcome.

We strongly recommend stopping by Beylerbeyi Profiterol for a fresh, tasty dessert — with a bonus of a friendly smile!

user_review:
Anam Mantı—inanılmaz lezzetli!

We didn’t know what to expect walking in, especially as longtime loyalists to the Bodrum Mantı chain—but the moment we saw the teyze in the front window hand-rolling fresh dough, we knew we were in for something special. That’s the real sign of a place that cooks with heart.

And wow—this was next level. The mantı was fresh, rich, beautifully spiced, and absolutely unforgettable. Dare we say it? It might even be better than Bodrum Mantı. (Okay… it is.)

Everything tasted ev yapımı—like it came straight from someone’s home kitchen, with love and generations of practice behind it.

Şiddetle tavsiye edilir.

If you’re anywhere nearby: go. Sit. Eat. And thank the teyze on your way out. 💛🥟🇹🇷

user_review:
It's no wonder they get so many good reviews. We tried the food and it was amazing. It really lived up to our expectations.

There was just one slight omission. First, we ordered the sunrise set, but it didn't come with the cold smoke attraction featured in many videos on social media. It was a bit disappointing, but at least the sushi tasted good.

Our second menu, we ordered Deniz Ramen. The noodles and broth were delicious, but the toppings on the ramen were only 3 small slices of squid, a few slice of crab sticks, one egg, and more mushrooms. However, the portion of noodles and broth was quite large, so it was quite filling.

The location is easy to find. The restaurant's ambiance is also nice and the friendly waiters are also a good point for this restaurant.

Overall, worth it.

description: Doğa Kır Tesisleri - İmrahor, 34275 Arnavutköy/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at the restaurant next to Istanbul Airport, and it was truly a delightful experience from start to finish. From the moment I stepped in, I was greeted with warm smiles and impeccable service that made me feel right at home.

The highlight of my visit had to be the breakfast spread they offered. It was a feast for the senses, with a wide array of fresh and delicious options to choose from. The variety of cheeses, pastries, fruits, and Turkish delights made for a breakfast lover's dream come true. Their freshly brewed coffee and selection of teas perfectly complemented the meal.

What truly sets this restaurant apart, though, is the breathtaking view it offers. As I enjoyed my breakfast, I couldn't help but be captivated by the panoramic vista of the airport and its surroundings. It was a peaceful and picturesque way to start the day, and I couldn't get enough of it.

Now, let's talk about prices. Despite the high quality of the food, service, and view, I was pleasantly surprised by the affordability of the menu. It's not often you find such a combination of great value and exceptional quality in an airport restaurant.

In conclusion, if you find yourself at Istanbul Airport and are in need of a fantastic breakfast spot with a view that will take your breath away, look no further than this restaurant. The welcoming service, delicious food, stunning views, and reasonable prices make it a true gem. It's an experience I won't forget, and I can't wait to return on my next visit to Istanbul.

description: Sirazen Döner - Bağlar, Mimar Sinan Cd No:78, 34209 Bağcılar/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
Update - Visited today 05 July 2026 9pm+.

I have visited this place a few times and I have always ordered the mixed kebab. Although the price has gone up but I think it is still reasonable and the mixed kebab is always good. The service by the young waiters are always pleasant and prompt. But this time round while paying my bill, when the young waiter brought the credit card machine and bill to me, the older waiter with white/grey short hair (he seems like the head waiter) came over and snatched the machine away from the young guy. Then he punched in 200 TL on a machine and showed me, saying "TIP, service charge". Basically he was forcing me to pay a tip. I told him I came here many times, there is no such thing in the past. But he just repeated the same thing. To be fair the 2 young waiters did well, and does deserve a tip. But to be forced to pay a tip, the action itself is an unpleasant ending to a nice meal and does not deserve any tip at all. All in all, an unpleasant and sad ending at this restaurant after dining here a few times and every single time I stay at the hotel opposite. I will not be coming back for sure.

user_review: Delicious fish and the most succulent calamari. If you have ability issues , you may want to skip the stairs to the additional dining rooms. user_review:
As an American, I love this restaurant. I accidentally found this place on a overnight layover in Istanbul and  stumbled in here. I saw other travelers (and locals) eat here wuite a lot too. I met some Filipina friends already eating and asked to join them.

Now every time I have a long layover in Istanbul I stay at a hotel nearby so I can eat a meal here. Ill post pictures if the menu but honestly for the price its very good and I dont think you can go wrong. This plate with meat, veggies, rice, pita was less than $9. The knuafe which I love is so good and authentic, and ive been to Palestine in the west bank where it originated. Service here is all very friendly and they make the food very fast. Not all the workers speak english well but its easy to communicate with them and they are very honorable, they will not scam you. They accept credit cards as well which makes it convenient if you dont want to have lira.

I will be back in 2 weeks and cant wait to try it again! Its so yummy!

user_review:
We recently tried Dasdas, a stylish new restaurant in the courtyard.
You can tell the freshness of the ingredients while eating. The dough was thin and perfectly cooked. The sauce was very balanced. We tried the classic American pizza and it was excellent. We would like to thank Chef Neşe Hanım for her hard work and dedication; she added her own touch 🤌🏼🙏🏼
Even though we ate around 11:30 PM, it didn't make us feel bloated at all. The service was friendly and as wonderful as the pizzas. A great, authentic pizza place has arrived in the area. There's also a stylish cocktail bar inside, and they sometimes have live music events, which could be more experienced if you happen to be there :)
As someone who often plays games at Dasdas, I will continue to eat here. Thank you everyone 🙏🏼

user_review:
I went to this burger place during winter, when it was only open indoor because of the gloomy weather. At first, it might seem a bit scary, but my wife told me that in the summer, it becomes a lively outdoor spot with a much better vibe.

Now, let’s talk about the burgers. They are amazing! I can’t even describe how delicious each one is. They have a huge variety of options, around 34 in total, all made with fresh, homemade ingredients. Even the buns are freshly baked (homemade & baked my hand).

I think the owner makes these incredible burgers himself. I was so impressed with his kindness and professionalism in making such mouthwatering sandwiches. And let’s not forget that he speaks English clearly, so it’s easy for customers to talk to him.

I highly recommend this burger joint and will definitely be going back whenever I’m in Istanbul.

name: Arjantin Burger Beylikdüzü
address: Kavaklı, Yeşilyurt Cd. no: 17/2B H blok Ofis:214, 34520 Beylikdüzü/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: Arjantin Burger Beylikdüzü - Kavaklı, Yeşilyurt Cd. no: 17/2B H blok Ofis:214, 34520 Beylikdüzü/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
I originally wanted to order the regular 150g Argentina burger, but the waitress told me it wasn’t available and only offered the 300g version instead. That made no sense — if you can make two 150g patties for the larger burger, why not just serve the single 150g version?

It felt like a clear upsell attempt. And honestly, who expects a 14-year-old to eat a 300g meat burger?

When I asked how much the 300g burger costs, she pointed at the original 530₺ price on the menu and said, “50₺ more.” So I was charged 580₺ for something listed as 530₺ — how does that make sense?

As for the burger itself — the taste was disappointing. The meat didn’t taste like real beef at all. It had an odd, soft texture and clearly wasn’t 100% beef. There were fillers, additives, and so many sauces and cheeses piled on top that it felt like a sloppy mess trying to cover up the low quality. My kids didn’t feel good after eating there.

To top it off, drinks weren’t included with the meal, and I had to pay extra for those. In the end, I was charged 1060₺. Here’s the breakdown of what I exactly ordered.
•	Argentina burger: 530₺
•	3-piece kids burger: 300₺
•	Two Fuse Teas: 70₺ each = 140₺
Total should have been: 970₺
Yet I was charged 1060₺. I honestly don’t know where the extra 90₺ came from.
The receipt it self is very sketchy, it didn’t have the break down of each item and it’s cost🤦🏻‍♀️. Total rip off.

What makes this worse is there’s burger places just around the corner and down the block that serves way better burgers — tastier, better quality, and much more worth the price. I wish I had just gone there instead.

user_review:
Beeves Diner is one of those places that instantly puts a smile on your face. The smash burgers are absolutely spot on — juicy, flavorful, and clearly made with care. You can really taste the difference when everything is produced in-house; it adds a level of trust and quality that’s hard to find, especially at such reasonable prices.

What makes the experience even more special is the atmosphere. With an air hockey table and a classic Street Fighter arcade machine, it genuinely takes you back to childhood. For a moment, you feel like you’ve stepped into a laid-back American diner — fun, nostalgic, and full of character.

And a special mention to Sidar Chef — he clearly knows exactly what he’s doing. The attention to detail, both in the food and the overall concept, really shows.

Great food, great vibe, and great value. Definitely a spot worth going back to.

user_review:
Mariam Coffee is a Palestinian café I absolutely love! They serve the best coffee with consistently high quality. Their treats are always fresh, and the cozy vibe, calm music, and warm, family-like staff create an inviting atmosphere. You can feel the Palestinian generosity in every detail—no matter how long you stay, you’ll always want to return.

The café is creative and constantly updating its menu. Their coffee corner is also packed with great gift options. There’s plenty of parking available, and the space is always clean and super comfortable, whether you’re meeting friends, reading from their rich book collection, or working on your laptop. Highly recommended!

Perfect in every way! 👏

Meos at Istanbul Akvaryum is an absolute treasure. I was so impressed that I ended up dining there five days in a row - and every visit was exceptional. The seafood is incredibly fresh, from delicious starters to perfectly grilled fish, and the Turkish desserts are simply wonderful. 🫠

The service is both professional and warmly friendly, and the hospitality is truly outstanding. A special thank you to the kind owner Taner, who makes every guest feel genuinely welcome. 🤗

If you’re in Istanbul and want unforgettable seafood with top-class service, Meos is a place you cannot miss. Highly recommended! 👍😃

description: Agora Meyhanesi 1890 - Balat, Mürselpaşa Cd. no:185, 34087 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
This meyhane in Balat had been on our list for years because of its history and cultural background. Finally, we had the chance to try it on a Friday evening. The first impression was quite positive: the entrance is cozy yet historical at the same time, and on the left there is a small display showcasing the rakı-making process.
Once you go upstairs to the actual restaurant, the atmosphere becomes even more appealing. The ambiance is so authentic that, for a moment, you truly start to feel nostalgic for old-fashioned Istanbul. Unfortunately, all these pleasant feelings come to an end once you order.
The mezes are mediocre and the menu lacks a clear structure or concept. We ordered girit ezmesi, which is supposed to be made with basil, but what we received was a very sweet, cheese-and-pistachio paste. The hummus was bitter, and the levrek marin was covered in so much sauce that it was almost impossible to taste the fish itself.
The restaurant itself and its atmosphere are certainly worth experiencing, but the food, unfortunately, is not worth it at all.

user_review:
A Hidden Gem on Büyükada – Club Mavi

Club Mavi is an absolute treasure on Büyükada Island. Nestled on top of the hill, it offers breathtaking panoramic views that set the perfect atmosphere for an unforgettable dining experience.

The food is nothing short of spectacular. Their selection of fresh fish is exceptional, bursting with flavour and expertly prepared. The Turkish dishes are equally impressive, offering a delicious and authentic taste of the region. Everything is served with attention to detail, showcasing the chefs’ passion for quality and flavour.

What truly elevates Club Mavi is the warm and welcoming staff. Polite, attentive, and genuinely friendly, they make you feel right at home, ensuring your visit is as enjoyable as possible.

Despite its premium quality and stunning location, the prices are refreshingly reasonable, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking for a perfect combination of great food, stunning views, and top-notch service.

A must-visit when on Büyükada – Club Mavi is a dining experience you’ll cherish!

user_review:
This is hands down the best place for burgers in Istanbul. The restaurant is quite spacious, boasting two floors and a thoughtfully designed smoking area. The ambiance is inviting and comfortable, making it an ideal spot for a casual meal. The service is excellent; the staff promptly provides the menu as soon as you sit down, ensuring a seamless dining experience.

While the prices are above average, the quality justifies the cost. The burgers are exceptionally delicious, crafted with fresh ingredients and bursting with flavor. The fries are phenomenal—crispy on the outside and perfectly seasoned. We ordered cheese chicken burgers, which were particularly impressive, showcasing the restaurant's dedication to high-quality food.

Overall, this burger joint offers an unparalleled dining experience in Istanbul. It is highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy a fantastic burger and top-notch service.

user_review: If you're looking for a truly authentic experience, this Turkish traditional breakfast bar is a must-visit. The spread is a delightful mix of fresh ingredients, with creamy cheeses, olives, honey, jams, and a selection of savory items like sucuk (spicy sausage) and menemen (scrambled eggs with tomatoes and peppers). The warm, flaky simit (Turkish sesame bread) pairs perfectly with a glass of strong, aromatic Turkish tea. The atmosphere is casual yet inviting, offering a glimpse into Turkish breakfast culture. Perfect for those wanting a delicious start to the day!

user_review: I took a fresh levrek fish. And I asked the grilling woman. Is this for somebody. She said no. I bought it, payed for it at the cashier with some sautéed mushrooms. I gave it to the grilling lady. With the number on top. And my mistake was that i kept the two numbers on top of the fish. After grilling, the fish was ready. And she didn’t give it to me at all. I told her. How would you make me pay 276 tl for only sautéed mushrooms? She wanted to see the receipt. I gave it to her. She didn’t believe me until we told the cashier to solve the problem. She told me do you remember what was the number? I told her no. Then they offered me another fresh fish and until now nobody took the first plate of fish that I originally bought. The griller lady maybe wanted to eat it. So please when going there take care of your number and receipt.

user_review: Why would the CHP build a city restaurant in Arnavutköy? This concrete jungle of a city is getting another concrete jungle, and the IMM (Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality) is building a city restaurant there. Look, this city gains a neighborhood, but it's actually depleting the city's resources. But if you ask the CHP, they're against the Canal Istanbul project. If you're against it, you shouldn't be encouraging people to live in a neighborhood built for the Canal Istanbul project. Tell me if I'm wrong, oppose this; this isn't good municipal governance. I'm writing this as someone who isn't pro-government, believe me, but in this country, if the opposition isn't strong, the government will do anything. Anyway, there's much more to write, but I won't take up your time; it's already too long for a comment that won't change anything. If you've read this far, thank you; at least your screen time isn't 2 seconds.

user_review:
We had a wonderful experience at Hatay Gurmet! The food was exceptional from start to finish. We ordered a kebab plate, several mezes, and soups, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. There was honestly nothing left on our plates because every dish was so delicious.

The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere made us feel very welcome. To finish, we had the künefe, which was absolutely amazing crispy, perfectly sweet, and one of the best we've had.

If you're looking for authentic Turkish cuisine with generous portions and excellent quality, I can highly recommend Hatay Gurmet. We will definitely be coming back!

Cafe Mikel Avcılar : A Cozy Spot for Delicious coffee

Located in the heart of Avcılar , Cafe Mikel is a charming little spot that offers a delightful escape from the hustle and bustle of the city. With its cozy atmosphere and welcoming staff, this cafe has quickly become one of my favorite places to enjoy a drink …

Upon entering Cafe Mikel, I was immediately struck by the warm and inviting decor. The rustic wooden tables, plush couches, and soft lighting created a relaxed and comfortable ambiance that made me feel right at home. The friendly staff greeted me with a smile and promptly seated me at a table by the window, offering a lovely view of the bustling street outside.

I decided to try a mexican coffee, The flavors were fresh and vibrant

In terms of value for money, I found the prices to be reasonable considering the quality of the drinks. The portion sizes were generous, and I left feeling satisfied and content.

Overall, my experience was delightful, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a cozy spot to enjoy a coffee . I look forward to returning soon to try more of their menu offerings and soak up the welcoming atmosphere once again.

user_review:
We'd been looking for an opportunity to try it since we saw it had just opened. We went under the pretext of celebrating a birthday. We sat in the non-smoking section. You can also watch the children's area on screens. The atmosphere was very comfortable and spacious. I think it would be even more enjoyable if the outdoor balcony area were open in the summer.

Despite being a large table with children, the service was fast. Appetizers, hot dishes, drinks, ice, water, and everything else we needed were served continuously. The table was cleaned and the service was updated. Tea, coffee, fruit, and liqueurs were also complimentary.

We liked the appetizers, the stuffed meatballs, and the lahmacun (Turkish pizza). I also recommend trying the Albanian liver. I remember the spoon salad being chopped a bit smaller; this one seemed a little undercooked to us. The meats were incredibly tender. The crispy chicken was juicy and tender, a contrast to its name, but very delicious. I can't leave out the praise for the Adana kebab; it was also very well prepared; the meat, spices, and cooking were ideal. I didn't drink it, but those who did weren't very happy with the turnip juice. The desserts were also terrible; the kadayıf and semolina pudding with ice cream were so bad they were a waste of time after all the meze and meat. The price per portion seems expensive, but for a table with raki, meat, meze, and dessert, it cost around 2000-2500 TL per person. We were satisfied and will most likely go again. Kudos to the whole team!

address: İnönü, Nenehatun Sokağı no:8, 34755 Ataşehir/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: Rakel - İnönü, Nenehatun Sokağı no:8, 34755 Ataşehir/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Rakel, a stunning “Yeni nesil meyhane” perched on one of the seven hills of Istanbul. From the moment we stepped in, I was captivated by the breathtaking views that swept across the city, particularly as the sun set, painting the sky in hues of orange and deep blue. The panoramic view alone is worth the visit, offering a truly unique perspective of Istanbul that is both romantic and awe-inspiring.

The ambiance at Rakel is a perfect blend of modern sophistication and traditional warmth. The service was impeccable, with staff members who were not only attentive and professional but also exuded genuine warmth and hospitality. Their dedication to making sure every aspect of our experience was flawless was evident in every interaction. The setting is ideal for both intimate dinners and larger gatherings, as I discovered during our visit with family members.

Now, onto the food, which was nothing short of extraordinary. The mezes were an absolute highlight of the evening. Each dish was a masterful blend of flavors and textures, showcasing both creativity and a deep respect for traditional Turkish cuisine. The variety of mezes was impressive, each prepared with the freshest ingredients and presented beautifully. The eggplant dishes were particularly memorable, with rich, smoky flavors that left us craving more. The hummus, creamy and perfectly seasoned, was another standout, as were the zesty chickpea salads that added a delightful crunch and freshness to the meal.

What truly set Rakel apart was the balance they struck between honoring the classic elements of a meyhane and introducing innovative twists that brought a contemporary flair to the table. Every bite was a testament to the culinary expertise of the kitchen, where tradition meets modernity in the most delightful way.

In addition to the outstanding food, the drinks selection was equally impressive. The traditional rakı, served ice-cold, paired perfectly with the mezes, enhancing the overall dining experience. The drinks menu also offered a thoughtful selection of wines and cocktails, catering to a variety of tastes.

Visiting Rakel with my partner and family members made for an unforgettable evening. The combination of exceptional food, world-class service, and the unbeatable view of Istanbul created a dining experience that is hard to match. I would highly recommend Rakel to anyone looking to enjoy the very best of what a modern meyhane can offer, all while being surrounded by the timeless beauty of Istanbul. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, Rakel is a must-visit destination that will leave you with memories to cherish long after the meal is over.

user_review: This was one of my favorite steak restaurants in Istanbul, not because of their high quality steak and comfortable environment,but because of their tulum salad which i think is most delicious salad i have ever had. However recently i am really disappointed about their way of changing size of salad. As you can see the first picture is their current "large" tulum salad which is smaller than previous small tulum salad. The second picture is their previous large tulum salad. It is way more smaller but price is increased again and again. And they even remove walnuts from the salad! I once thought this phenomenon just happened by chance, but after visiting their restaurant many times, i found this has became their normal way of offering salad. address: Merkez, Çiğdem Cd. No: 52G, 34310 Avcılar/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: cafe Lumiere Avcılar(İstanbul) - Merkez, Çiğdem Cd. No: 52G, 34310 Avcılar/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
I stumbled upon this café by chance while passing by, the atmosphere inside was lovely and refreshing.
I believe the manager was there as well, he was very kind and welcoming💕

I ordered the cold milk tea with boba. Honestly, I really wanted to try an iced coffee with boba, but they said they didn’t have that option. I’m not a big fan of sweet drinks, but I ordered the milk tea anyway because I love boba. As they warned me, it was indeed quite sweet…but I can’t complain since that’s how it’s meant to be.
I do wish they would add an iced latte with boba to the menu that would be amazing Other than that, the boba itself was delicious and soft — actually one of the best I’ve had in Türkiye.

The preparation took a little time, maybe 10 to 15 minutes, but I didn’t mind because the atmosphere inside was pleasant and I spent the time exploring the place, the prices were very reasonable also✨

They also have a cute corner where they sell Korean souvenirs and various items at really good prices. I forgot to ask, but I think there’s also a spot where you can try on traditional outfits and take photos, it would be a wonderful experience for anyone interested!

Overall, it was a lucky stop, and if I visit this area again, I’d definitely drop by to try something else. But seriously… I really hope they add a coffee boba option someday.. from the bottom of my heart!😔🤍

user_review:
I think this is, by far, one of the best burger places in Ataşehir. I’ll decide if it’s the best later on, after a few more visits—there are still some burgers on my list that I want to try.

One of the things that makes this place stand out from other burger spots (I’d mention FO Burger and BOB Burger) is the bun—please keep using it. Also, the size of the burger is just right, enough to satisfy your appetite.

The meat is great and juicy. The truffle sauce was also very tasty—I like that it’s well balanced. Some places use so much sauce that you can’t even taste the meat anymore.

Thanks for opening this place, and keep up the good work!

description: İhtiyar Balıkçı Restaurant - Yeşilköy, İskele Cd. No:24, 34149 Bakırköy/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
For foreign visitors, this place should be avoided. Their businesses practices are immoral.

The first warning sign for us was the absence of menus and therefore pricing. So we had no clue if we were paying a fair price or we were being extorted by restaurant.

But the food prices, we felt, were fair. The food was of reasonable quality.

But sadly, this business felt it appropriate to charge ₺2,500 for four diners. And ₺950 of that was for a single bottle of Turkish wine. That’s right - the restaurant inflated the price to ten times what it should have been! For a good quality bottle of wine, fair enough, but let’s remind ourselves that Turkey isn’t the first country that springs to mind when you think ‘wine’.

A frankly disgusting and dishonest business and one that deserves to fail.

Avoid, avoid, avoid.

Lastly a mixed fruit juice that was refreshing and reminiscent of Arab style juices.

description: Famone Coffee | Chocolate - İnönü, Hoca Ahmet Yesevi Cd. No:7/B, 34200 Bağcılar/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review: This is a place we've been to three times and were completely dissatisfied with each visit. I have no complaints about the atmosphere and service, but the desserts are either mediocre or really need improvement. On our first visit, we ordered Lotus Waffles and Oreo Waffles. They were served warm and crispy, but there was so little chocolate that we basically just ate fried waffle batter. On our second visit, we tried pancakes and a chocolate bowl. I remember paying an exorbitant price for five tiny pancakes, and the bowl had no chocolate at all; it was just pastry cream and fruit. Today, since it had been a long time and it was on our way, we decided to try the Paris Brest. It was awful. We ate it because we paid for it, hahaha. It didn't have praline cream inside, it had pastry cream from a bowl, what's the connection? Moreover, it's visible in the photo that the pastry dough had collapsed due to the wrong cream and there was a syrup-like substance. It was very bad. Unfortunately, God's right is three, we will not choose it again 🥲

address: Cevizlik, Sakızlı Yalı Sk. No:5, 34140 Bakırköy/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: Gusto Napoletano - Cevizlik, Sakızlı Yalı Sk. No:5, 34140 Bakırköy/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
TL:TR Overrated overpriced but okay for trying once
I had this place saved on my list for the longest time and was genuinely excited to finally try it after seeing so many photos and videos. Naturally, my expectations were very high.
Waiters are nice but at some point they were laughing at us we were a bit too loud and fighting about the taste so i get it .
We got there and it was almost full, but thankfully waiting wasn’t an issue. We checked the menu and were honestly a little surprised by the prices. Still, we wanted to give it a fair shot because we understand that quality ingredients come at a cost—especially if they’re using premium products. But even keeping that in mind… it does feel overpriced.
Taste-wise, it was good , I can’t say it was bad at all. In fact, the dough was probably the highlight for me; easily the best part of the pizza.
Tried pesto Burata, mantarli and pastırma one burrta felt so dull it needs a little more pesto and sauce flavor , mantarli one wasn't bad but i didn't like it that much
But overall, I expected more. Maybe because of the hype, maybe because of the price, maybe both but I left feeling slightly disappointed.
I’m glad I tried it, and it was definitely a nice one-time experience, but unfortunately, it’s not somewhere I see myself going back to agin

user_review:
We visited this restaurant knowing that it was a tourist trap, but we wanted to have dinner with a nice view and expected high-quality, very good food.
The service was good. They helped us choose our meals and took good care of us. As for the food itself, it was average, and on subsequent days we had better food in much cheaper restaurants.
The prices are very exaggerated; €85 for a plate of fish without any taste is a huge disproportion. The salad with various types of fish was tiny, as was the portion of kofte.
We got a free dessert (baklava, which was quite dry) and tea.
When paying, the waiter basically asked for a tip, and only later did we notice on the bill that a service fee had already been added.
The view of the city was amazing, and the restaurant itself is nice and clean. But it's definitely not worth the price.

user_review:
I stayed in Avcilar, Istanbul in late September/early October 2024 for medical tourism and had the pleasure of eating at this restaurant. I actually learned of this place from my medical provider who ordered a delicious lunch for me from Tas Degirmen - meatballs with fries, salad and soup. It was the best meal I had during my whole trip to Istanbul.

The next day I went here to dine in for lunch. I had pizza and the meatballs again, and everything was delicious. The service was perfectly fine, and the pricing was reasonable.

There aren't many decent food options in the area near the Encore Ramada Avcilar hotel, so I ordered dinner from Tas Degirmen later during my visit. This was my 3rd meal eating here in less than a week, which tells you how good the food is here.

For anyone staying at the Encore Ramada, I would highly recommend eating here at least once.

user_review: This year, we took our sacrificial meat to Yayla Kasap Gazi and his sons for processing. They charged us around 120 TL per kilo, including packaging. Our request was for lean diced meat and minced meat with the fat removed. Unfortunately, the diced meat was barely diced; the minced meat was full of fat and sinew. If you're not going to remove the fat, why did we pay 6000 TL? We could have just added all the fat and sinew to the minced meat at home. I was dissatisfied and will absolutely never go there again or recommend it. By the way, the packaging, which they charged us for per kilo, was terrible. I repackaged all the minced meat. Some of the diced meat was left over. I can't attach a picture of the processed diced meat that arrived at our house.

user_review:
We chose this restaurant due to its location and tranquil ambiance as well as the clean tables with island-style white covers, and we were very glad we did. The staff are very attentive and friendly, especially chef Ibrahim Bey is very passionate and cordial.
All the cold and hot starters, including the fresh and delicious fava garnished with excellent olive oil and the muska böregi filled with white cheese were superb. As for fish, we followed the chef's recommendation and ordered istavrit (horse mackerel) and tekir (surmullet). Both were very fresh and gorgeous, especially the tekir could be the best I have ever eaten!!! As for dessert, you should definitely order the fantastic, baked tahini halva in casserole. Total recommendation, either out in summer with the sea at your feet or in winter under the cozy tent!!!

Good food, fast service. I mean, it’s not just good, it’s freaking amazing tasty food.
We even stopped going to the other Asian restaurants in Istanbul, because we know that in Sushibacks food will always be really tasty.
It’s been around a year since we tried food from this restaurant first time and we are still 100% fans of this place. Used to we only had delivery, but lately visited the restaurant itself.
Definitely, by the look of it, you can think that this is one of the dozens “asian” fast foods. To be honest, if we would not know how amazing the food is, we would never enter the restaurant.

But frankly, as soon as you eat such a great food, you don’t care that you eat it on the wobbly table.

P.S. food always packed very well, we never had an incident.

description: Köfteci Mahmut - Merkez, Hüsniye Sk. 8A, 34820 Beykoz/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
Just a straight forward köfte, made by meats picked carefully from a meat vendor in the small town of Riva almost 30 minutes away from where the shop is. The meat is selected from the short rips part with a high content of fat. It is then minced and mixed with a tiny bit of wet bread, and few whole eggs with salt, cumin and maby some black pepper... that is it. Simple flavors of wholesome ingredients came together to give you a balanced flavor.
The soup was fine too, the lentil flavor was dominant and apparent. The Piyaz  salad was OK. I only wished there was a slaça source next to the köfte as it would enhanced the flavors even more.
Overall it was a lovely experience, where we fond ourselves in a very narrow alley between old wooden homes exchanging a friendly talk with the owners.
If you were around give them a try, you will not regret it.

user_review:
Kardelen is a fantastic stop, especially late at night or early in the morning, for a healing bowl of soup. The star here is definitely the mixed offal soup. Karışık çorba comes 'terbiye edilmemiş' (clear broth: without thickening with lemon and egg); this is the only way to truly appreciate the real flavor of the meat broth and the ingredients.

The complimentary appetizers that arrive at the table before you even order are a very nice touch. The venue isn't very fancy; it has a friendly atmosphere, but the flavors are spot on. Staples of Southeastern Anatolian cuisine, like Beyran, are also available on the menu.

We finished our meal with Zerde dessert. Zerde is essentially an Ottoman legacy dish. It originated as a Persian-influenced rice dish that the Ottomans refined into a high-class dessert used to mark the most important milestones in life: birth, marriage, and death. It is floral and sweet. The saffron provides an earthy, metallic floral taste, often balanced with rose water.
It is usually garnished with currants, shredded coconut, pine nuts, and pomegranate seeds.

Prices were pretty reasonable. Portion was very big, personnel were friendly and the service was quick. The store is open 24 hours.

Overall score 4.2/5 for an Oftal Restaurant.

user_review:
Very Disappointed .

We ordered kebab and what arrived was processed meat stuck to wooden sticks. Not real skewers, the meat was pressed onto flat pieces of wood, which clearly reduces the amount of meat you get.

The plate itself was strange. A few small pieces of this low-quality meat, fries, one pepper and rice. I’ve eaten Turkish food more than 10 times, and this is the first time I’ve ever seen kebab served with rice like this.

The taste was bad. Dry, bland, and with a strange industrial flavor. No real grill taste at all.

At the restaurant, we immediately told the staff that something was wrong and asked them to check the food. Instead of listening, the waiter ignored us, avoided the conversation, and became slightly aggressive in his attitude. Because of this, we decided not to argue, paid the bill, and left.

We left with a very bad feeling of having been scammed, which is sad to experience in an otherwise beautiful country.

I do not recommend this place.

when in turkey you need to have a turkish breakfast. at least i knew i needed to. me and my friend went above and beyond trying to find the right place: affordable, but with good quality and generous portions. in the end we settled for this one and i honestly couldn’t have had a better experience.

first of all, the tea is unlimited. i drank at least six cups. after breakfast they even bring you coffee as well. the breakfast spread has everything you can imagine and more. every key element of a traditional turkish breakfast is perfectly represented: menemen (the tomato and egg dish), sucuk (turkish sausage), kuymak (the cheesy cornmeal dish), börek, a variety of cheeses like beyaz peynir, kaşar and dil peyniri, olives, honey and butter, jams, acı ezme, fresh tomatoes and cucumbers, and even simit and sigara böreği.

everything was delicious, comforting and very well done. me and my friend were so full we basically rolled out of the place. couldn’t recommend it more.

user_review:
Although the number of cafes in the area is rapidly increasing, this place definitely deserves first place in some key aspects. It has a sustainable approach, especially regarding healthy and fresh food. No matter what time you go, the tea feels freshly brewed, and the coffee is made from fresh beans. The desserts are light, fresh, and won't cause a spike in your blood sugar. However, I mostly prefer the savory options. At any time of day, you can find addictive treats like Bosnian burek or poğaça (a type of pastry) prepared by expert hands.

Their attention to hygiene is at a level that would make other businesses in the area envious; impeccable cleanliness prevails from the kitchen to the restrooms.

As a local who spends a lot of time in the area, I can say that if your goal is quality service and a great food and drink experience, I wholeheartedly recommend this place.

name: Bellini
address: Yıldız, Çırağan Cd. No:32, 34349 Beşiktaş/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: Bellini - Yıldız, Çırağan Cd. No:32, 34349 Beşiktaş/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review: This restaurant is located in the old palace side of the Kempinski Ciragan, which in itself is already a plus to the whole experience. Dining here is part of a fuller thing, not just the culinary side. The view on the Bosphorus is unforgettable.  Gastronomically we loved the mix/match concept of different kinds of pasta and sauces, then there are the specialties such as the lobster pasta which comes in one size. They also offer two sizes (70gr/140gr) at two respective prices for the other pasta. The pasta is also homemade and excellently cooked and served. Our friend had the tuna which was fresh but somewhat undercooked, which they immediately remedied. The bruschetta was nothing to write home about but the olive oil that was served apart was gorgeous. Unmissable is their tiramisu which is quite a generous portion but still somewhat overpriced. Even though we reserved well in advance we could not be promised outside seating on their terrace, which is particularly small.  A table ultimately freed for dessert time and they moved us there. The interior of the restaurant is still superb.  All staff were warm and accommodating but special thanks go to Gizem who served us warmly with a smile and with special attention to our allergies.  All in all an enjoyable dining experience.

name: Adile Sultan Ev Yemekleri- Bayrampaşa Restoranı (Ekspres)
address: Kocatepe, Şehir Parkı Caddesı No:151A, 34000 Bayrampaşa/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: Adile Sultan Ev Yemekleri- Bayrampaşa Restoranı (Ekspres) - Kocatepe, Şehir Parkı Caddesı No:151A, 34000 Bayrampaşa/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
On May 26, 2026, at 7:51 PM, I ordered a chicken-based meal from Adile Sultan Ev Yemekleri, located at 151a Şehir Parkı Caddesi, Kocatepe Mahallesi, Bayrampaşa, Istanbul, via Yemeksepeti. My order number is #og6z-2622-yvpz. My order included bulgur pilaf, double grilled chicken topped with bulgur pilaf, 6-7 pieces of plain bread, and a complimentary chicken broth soup.

After eating this chicken meal, I began experiencing nausea and abdominal pain around 5:00 AM. Around 7:10-7:20 AM, a relative took me to the İstinye Medical Park emergency room. There, they charged approximately 20,000 TL for treatment, including IV fluids and additional medication. Since my family cannot afford this, I was forced to leave the emergency room without receiving treatment.

Later, around 7:40 AM, I went to the state hospital, but I didn't receive proper or adequate treatment there either. I came home around 8:15-8:20 AM, rested for 3-4 hours, but after waking up, the pain worsened instead of subsiding. Around 12:00 PM, I started vomiting violently, throwing up the entire chicken meal I had eaten, along with the vegetables. That day was like torture; my stomach constantly ached, I couldn't go to the toilet, and the nausea never stopped.

This time, around 1:00 PM, I went to Bezmialem Hospital. Since I couldn't go on my own, a relative took me. In the emergency room, the doctor diagnosed me with diarrhea and gastroenteritis (a09), suspected to be infectious, and it was assessed as food poisoning. They said it was caused by food I had eaten outside. I received intravenous fluid treatment there; a total of two IVs were administered. Despite this, my nausea worsened, and my abdominal pain didn't completely subside, although they said this could be normal in food poisoning. The whole day was torture and agony; I felt like I was going to die, I didn't even have the strength to get dressed.

I returned home around 3:30-3:40 PM and rested for about 9-10 hours. When I woke up at 1:38 AM, despite being so rested, my stomach was still aching. It's now around 3:07 AM as I write this complaint, and my whole day has been torture. I felt like I was going to faint from thirst, I lost a lot of fluids, and my blood pressure rose. For the examination and IV treatment I received at Bezmialem Hospital, I paid a total of 2665 + 680 TL, or 3345 TL in total, as shown in the documents.

During this process, I only consumed this chicken and meat-rich meal from Adile Sultan Ev Yemekleri, and I believe that the diagnosis I received at the hospital and the severe symptoms I experienced were caused by this order. Due to the health problems I experienced, the suffering I endured, and the expenses I incurred, I demand a refund of 3,345 TL for treatment and 612.5 TL for food orders I paid to Bezmialem Hospital. Otherwise, I will file a complaint with the Consumer Arbitration Board with all the hospital documents and evidence I have. I have also written about my problem on the Şikayetvar website, and I request that whoever reads this comment inform an authorized person. I cannot share the additional documents publicly here as they contain my private information, including my Turkish ID number and address. My complaint has also been submitted to Adile Sultan Hospital on Şikayetvar with all the documents and evidence.

name: U2 Istanbul Irish Pub
address: Şehit Muhtar, Bekar Sk. No:21, 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye
description: U2 Istanbul Irish Pub - Şehit Muhtar, Bekar Sk. No:21, 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye
user_review:
I’ve travelled to nearly 30 countries around the world, and I can honestly say that U2 Irish Pub in Istanbul is one of the most special pubs I’ve ever stepped into.

There’s something almost sacred about the atmosphere here. The passion, the stories, the music, the laughter, and the sense of community make it feel like so much more than just a pub. Walking through the doors feels like being welcomed into a family.

As someone who has spent years travelling the world, I’ve visited countless “Irish pubs” in different countries, but most are just themed bars. U2 is different. This place has soul. It has heart. It feels authentic in a way that’s difficult to put into words.

For a few hours, you genuinely feel like you’ve been transported straight to Ireland. I’ve never felt more connected to Irish culture, and I’ve never felt more like a true Irishman than sitting in this pub, sharing a drink, listening to the music, and soaking up the incredible atmosphere.

A massive credit goes to Leo, who helps create that feeling from the moment you arrive. His hospitality is second to none and he’s one of the main reasons people keep coming back.

If you’re in Istanbul and want an authentic Irish pub experience, don’t waste your time anywhere else. U2 Irish Pub isn’t just the best Irish pub in Istanbul—it’s one of the best pubs I’ve visited anywhere in the world.

user_review:
Whether you dine in or order take-out, this restaurant is highly recommended.

The menu offers an excellent variety of authentic Turkish dishes — from flavorful soups (çorba çeşitleri) like Ezo Gelin and Süzme Mercimek, to freshly baked lahmacun and pide, and a wide selection of kebabs including Adana, Urfa, Kilis Tava, and Tavuk Şiş. Portions are generous and beautifully presented.

The take-out packaging is clean and well-labeled, ensuring the food arrives warm and neatly arranged. Every dish maintains its taste and texture — tender grilled meats, smoky vegetables, and soft lavash bread. The side dishes such as onion salad, hummus, cacık, and şalgam complement the meal perfectly.

For dine-in, the restaurant ambiance feels inviting and comfortable, ideal for families or groups. Prices are fair considering the quality and portion sizes.

Overall:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Delicious food, well-prepared kebabs, friendly service, and authentic Turkish flavors. A great choice for both dine-in and takeaway.
